title: Run simplex to optimal or unbounded
heading: A Degenerate Vertex Has More Tight Rows Than It Needs, and Simplex Can Pivot Without Moving
cases: a bounded LP pivots to an optimal tableau and returns its value
an entering column with no positive entry stops the run as UNBOUNDED, not OPTIMAL
a row with right-hand side 0 and a positive entry wins the ratio test with ratio 0
